title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyper-parameter lambda (λ). It helps to prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients.

title: Effect of Lambda on Variance
text: As lambda (λ) increases, the penalty on large coefficients increases, which can reduce the model's complexity and variance. Consider what happens when λ decreases.

title: Lambda and Variance Relationship
text: What happens to the variance of the model's predictions as lambda (λ) decreases?

title: Observational Variance
text: Observational variance refers to the variability in the model's predictions. A lower lambda (λ) means less regularization, which can lead to higher variance in predictions.
